svg.title: Supply Chain Security (SLSA)
svg.desc: Supply Chain Security (SLSA). Prove that what you deploy was built from your source: build provenance, SBOMs, signatures and a check before every deploy. Step 1, An unguarded supply chain: A shared build server, a typosquat, a re-pushed :latest, and 4 days to find who ships a CVE. Step 2, Provenance and SBOMs: A fresh VM builds 4e7a1c; signed provenance and an SBOM attach to the image digest in ECR. Step 3, Sign and verify: Signed with a 10-min certificate; admission checks signer and provenance and rejects a laptop build. Step 4, Roadmap, payoff, limits: Build L2 now, L3 next; SBOMs list who ships a new CVE in 6 min, but only if someone queries them.
